<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Midnight Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }
  html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #070504;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    cursor: default;
  }
  canvas {
    display: block;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    touch-action: none;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="scene"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

  // Deterministic PRNG for rich organic detail
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function() {
      let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }

  // Respect prefers-reduced-motion dynamically
  const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let prefersReducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;
  reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
  });

  // Viewport & scene scale state
  let vw = 0, vh = 0, dpr = 1;
  let sceneScale = 1;
  let centerX = 0, centerY = 0;

  // Pointer & interactive state (normalized -1..1 relative to viewport center)
  const pointer = {
    tx: 0, ty: 0,       // target normalized (-1..1)
    x: 0, y: 0,         // smoothed camera parallax
    lx: -0.25, ly: -0.35, // smoothed key light offset
    vx: 0, vy: 0,       // pointer velocity
    prevX: 0, prevY: 0,
    active: false,
    overBroth: false
  };

  // Broth interactive ripples (in bowl-local space where broth rx=300, ry=174)
  const ripples = [];
  let lastRippleTime = 0;

  // Offscreen static textures (wood grain, ceramic speckle, ambient vignette)
  const woodCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  woodCanvas.width = 1024;
  woodCanvas.height = 512;
  const ceramicNoiseCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  ceramicNoiseCanvas.width = 256;
  ceramicNoiseCanvas.height = 256;

  function buildStaticTextures() {
    const rng = mulberry32(10842);

    // 1. Dark charred walnut / shou sugi ban counter grain
    const wctx = woodCanvas.getContext('2d');
    wctx.fillStyle = '#0c0806';
    wctx.fillRect(0, 0, 1024, 512);

    for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) {
      const y = rng() * 512;
      const h = 0.6 + rng() * 2.8;
      const alpha = 0.02 + rng() * 0.055;
      const warm = rng() > 0.45;
      wctx.fillStyle = warm
        ? `rgba(${38 + Math.floor(rng() * 28)}, ${23 + Math.floor(rng() * 16)}, ${14 + Math.floor(rng() * 10)}, ${alpha})`
        : `rgba(4, 2, 1, ${alpha * 1.4})`;
      wctx.beginPath();
      wctx.moveTo(0, y);
      const waveAmp = 1.5 + rng() * 5.5;
      const waveFreq = 0.004 + rng() * 0.008;
      const phase = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      for (let x = 0; x <= 1024; x += 32) {
        const wy = y + Math.sin(x * waveFreq + phase) * waveAmp;
        wctx.lineTo(x, wy);
      }
      wctx.lineTo(1024, y + h);
      wctx.lineTo(0, y + h);
      wctx.closePath();
      wctx.fill();
    }

    // Subtle pores in wood
    for (let i = 0; i < 900; i++) {
      const x = rng() * 1024;
      const y = rng() * 512;
      const len = 4 + rng() * 18;
      wctx.fillStyle = `rgba(3, 2, 1, ${0.12 + rng() * 0.18})`;
      wctx.fillRect(x, y, len, 0.8);
    }

    // 2. Ceramic stoneware organic iron-fleck texture
    const cctx = ceramicNoiseCanvas.getContext('2d');
    cctx.clearRect(0, 0, 256, 256);
    for (let i = 0; i < 1600; i++) {
      const x = rng() * 256;
      const y = rng() * 256;
      const r = 0.4 + rng() * 1.3;
      if (rng() > 0.5) {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 232, 205, ${0.015 + rng() * 0.03})`;
      } else {
        cctx.fillStyle = `rgba(12, 8, 6, ${0.04 + rng() * 0.09})`;
      }
      cctx.beginPath();
      cctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      cctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // Scene geometry data generated deterministically
  const sceneData = {
    noodles: [],
    oilDroplets: [],
    chiliDroplets: [],
    sesameSeeds: [],
    scallions: [],
    cornKernels: [],
    steamRibbons: [],
    motes: [],
    tofuGrillMarks: [],
    mushroomGills: []
  };

  function buildSceneData() {
    const rng = mulberry32(20261111);

    // 1. Wavy Alkaline Wheat Noodles (layered curves in center-left & deep broth)
    const noodleCount = 34;
    for (let i = 0; i < noodleCount; i++) {
      const depth = i / (noodleCount - 1); // 0 = deep submerged, 1 = surfacing
      const baseAngle = -0.35 + (rng() - 0.5) * 0.65;
      const cx = -35 + (rng() - 0.5) * 150;
      const cy = 22 + (rng() - 0.5) * 90;
      const length = 155 + rng() * 115;
      const waveFreq = 0.048 + rng() * 0.022;
      const waveAmp = 5.5 + rng() * 5.0;
      const phase = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const arch = (rng() - 0.35) * 28;
      const thickness = 5.0 + rng() * 1.9;

      sceneData.noodles.push({
        depth,
        cx, cy,
        baseAngle,
        length,
        waveFreq,
        waveAmp,
        phase,
        arch,
        thickness,
        swayOffset: rng() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    // 2. Golden Aromatic Scallion & Sesame Oil Droplets
    for (let i = 0; i < 68; i++) {
      const angle = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = Math.pow(rng(), 0.62) * 0.88;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * 282 * dist;
      const y = Math.sin(angle) * 160 * dist;
      const r = 1.6 + Math.pow(rng(), 2.1) * 9.5;
      sceneData.oilDroplets.push({
        x, y, r,
        stretch: 0.56 + rng() * 0.14,
        rot: (rng() - 0.5) * 0.4,
        driftPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        driftSpeed: 0.35 + rng() * 0.45,
        shimmer: rng() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    // 3. Ruby Rayu Chili Oil Pools & Pearls (clustered near front-left, center, and tofu)
    const chiliClusters = [
      { cx: -115, cy: 58, spread: 75, count: 24 },
      { cx: 35, cy: 74, spread: 68, count: 22 },
      { cx: -15, cy: -18, spread: 62, count: 16 },
      { cx: 145, cy: 48, spread: 52, count: 14 }
    ];
    for (const c of chiliClusters) {
      for (let i = 0; i < c.count; i++) {
        const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
        const d = Math.pow(rng(), 0.75) * c.spread;
        const x = c.cx + Math.cos(a) * d;
        const y = c.cy + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.6;
        // Keep inside broth ellipse
        if ((x * x) / (275 * 275) + (y * y) / (155 * 155) < 0.92) {
          const r = 2.0 + Math.pow(rng(), 1.8) * 11.5;
          sceneData.chiliDroplets.push({
            x, y, r,
            stretch: 0.54 + rng() * 0.14,
            driftPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
            hasFlake: rng() > 0.58,
            flakeAngle: rng() * Math.PI
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // 4. Fresh Bias-Cut Green Scallion Rings (Negi)
    const scallionCenter = { x: 8, y: 20 };
    for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const spread = i < 19 ? 54 : 135;
      const d = Math.pow(rng(), 0.75) * spread;
      const x = scallionCenter.x + Math.cos(a) * d * 1.15;
      const y = scallionCenter.y + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.68;
      const rx = 6.5 + rng() * 5.8;
      const ry = rx * (0.48 + rng() * 0.22);
      const rot = (rng() - 0.5) * 1.4;
      const tone = rng(); // 0 = pale white-green stem, 1 = vibrant emerald top
      sceneData.scallions.push({
        x, y, rx, ry, rot, tone,
        bobPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    // 5. Charred Sweet Corn Kernels (front-right warm golden cluster)
    const cornOrigin = { x: 118, y: 56 };
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = Math.pow(rng(), 0.68) * 52;
      const x = cornOrigin.x + Math.cos(a) * d * 1.1;
      const y = cornOrigin.y + Math.sin(a) * d * 0.64;
      const rot = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const size = 5.4 + rng() * 2.2;
      const charred = rng() > 0.52;
      sceneData.cornKernels.push({
        x, y, rot, size, charred,
        bobPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2
      });
    }

    // 6. Toasted White & Black Sesame Seeds + Ito Togarashi
    for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
      const a = rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const d = Math.pow(rng(), 0.65) * 235;
      const x = Math.cos(a) * d;
      const y = Math.sin(a) * d * 0.56 + 8;
      if ((x * x) / (270 * 270) + (y * y) / (152 * 152) < 0.88) {
        sceneData.sesameSeeds.push({
          x, y,
          rot: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
          isBlack: rng() > 0.72,
          bobPhase: rng() * Math.PI * 2
        });
      }
    }

    // 7. Volumetric Rising Steam Ribbons (multi-layered ethereal plumes)
    const ribbonCount = 15;
    for (let i = 0; i < ribbonCount; i++) {
      const spreadX = -205 + (i / (ribbonCount - 1)) * 410 + (rng() - 0.5) * 28;
      const originY = -30 + (rng() - 0.5) * 110;
      sceneData.steamRibbons.push({
        originX: spreadX,
        originY,
        height: 290 + rng() * 190,
        baseWidth: 26 + rng() * 32,
        topWidth: 95 + rng() * 95,
        speed: 0.22 + rng() * 0.18,
        phase: rng() * 100,
        swayAmp: 22 + rng() * 28,
        swayFreq: 1.4 + rng() * 1.2,
        opacity: 0.055 + rng() * 0.055,
        warmTint: rng() > 0.45
      });
    }

    // 8. Ambient Warm Bokeh & Floating Aromatic Vapor Motes
    for (let i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
      sceneData.motes.push({
        nx: (rng() - 0.5) * 2.2, // normalized scene coords
        ny: (rng() - 0.5) * 2.0,
        r: 1.0 + Math.pow(rng(), 2.4) * 5.2,
        speedY: 8 + rng() * 18,
        driftX: 6 + rng() * 16,
        phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
        alpha: 0.06 + rng() * 0.22,
        warm: rng() > 0.25
      });
    }
  }

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    vw = window.innerWidth;
    vh = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(vw * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(vh * dpr);

    // Base design space: bowl is ~740px wide, ~560px tall with steam headroom above
    const targetW = 960;
    const targetH = 820;
    sceneScale = Math.min(vw / targetW, vh / targetH) * 1.04;
    sceneScale = Math.max(0.34, Math.min(sceneScale, 1.65));

    centerX = vw * 0.5;
    // Place bowl slightly below vertical midpoint so rising steam has luxurious negative space
    centerY = vh * 0.565;
  }

  function spawnRipple(bx, by, strength = 1.0) {
    if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
    // Check if inside broth ellipse (rx=296, ry=170)
    const norm = (bx * bx) / (296 * 296) + (by * by) / (170 * 170);
    if (norm <= 0.98) {
      ripples.push({
        x: bx,
        y: by,
        age: 0,
        maxAge: 2.4,
        maxRadius: 65 + strength * 65,
        strength: Math.min(1.3, strength)
      });
      if (ripples.length > 10) ripples.shift();
    }
  }

  function screenToBowl(clientX, clientY) {
    const camX = pointer.x * 18 * sceneScale;
    const camY = pointer.y * 11 * sceneScale;
    const bx = (clientX - (centerX + camX)) / sceneScale;
    const by = (clientY - (centerY + camY)) / sceneScale;
    return { bx, by };
  }

  // Pointer & touch interaction
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    const nx = (e.clientX / Math.max(1, vw)) * 2 - 1;
    const ny = (e.clientY / Math.max(1, vh)) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.vx = nx - pointer.tx;
    pointer.vy = ny - pointer.ty;
    pointer.tx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, nx));
    pointer.ty = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny));
    pointer.active = true;

    const { bx, by } = screenToBowl(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    const brothNorm = (bx * bx) / (296 * 296) + ((by - 6) * (by - 6)) / (170 * 170);
    pointer.overBroth = brothNorm < 0.96;

    const now = performance.now();
    const speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
    if (pointer.overBroth && speed > 0.012 && now - lastRippleTime > 120) {
      spawnRipple(bx, by - 6, Math.min(1.0, speed * 14));
      lastRippleTime = now;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const nx = (e.clientX / Math.max(1, vw)) * 2 - 1;
    const ny = (e.clientY / Math.max(1, vh)) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.tx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, nx));
    pointer.ty = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny));

  function drawNoodles(time) {
    // Draw tangled artisanal golden alkaline wheat noodles partially submerged & cresting
    ctx.save();
    for (const n of sceneData.noodles) {
      const sway = prefersReducedMotion
        ? 0
        : Math.sin(time * 1.05 + n.swayOffset) * 1.8 * (0.4 + n.depth * 0.6);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(n.cx, n.cy + sway * 0.45);
      ctx.rotate(n.baseAngle);

      const steps = 18;
      const halfLen = n.length * 0.5;
      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        const u = s / steps; // 0..1
        const x = -halfLen + u * n.length;
        const env = Math.sin(u * Math.PI); // 0 at ends (submerged), 1 in middle (cresting)
        const crinkle = Math.sin(x * n.waveFreq + n.phase + sway * 0.35) * n.waveAmp;
        const y = crinkle * (0.45 + 0.55 * env) - Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * n.arch;
        pts.push({ x, y, env });
      }

      // Broth shadow underneath cresting strands
      if (n.depth > 0.25) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(68, 28, 6, ${0.18 + n.depth * 0.22})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness + 3.2;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.beginPath();
        pts.forEach((p, idx) => idx === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y + 3.2) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + 3.2));
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Main noodle body gradient (submerged ends blend smoothly into warm miso broth)
      const strandGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-halfLen, 0, halfLen, 0);
      const midAlpha = 0.35 + n.depth * 0.65;
      const rCol = Math.round(218 + n.depth * 28);
      const gCol = Math.round(154 + n.depth * 42);
      const bCol = Math.round(62 + n.depth * 32);

      strandGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(182, 106, 36, 0)`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(0.18, `rgba(${rCol - 20}, ${gCol - 24}, ${bCol - 18}, ${midAlpha * 0.72})`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${midAlpha})`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(0.82, `rgba(${rCol - 20}, ${gCol - 24}, ${bCol - 18}, ${midAlpha * 0.72})`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(1, `rgba(182, 106, 36, 0)`);

      ctx.strokeStyle = strandGrad;
      ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      pts.forEach((p, idx) => idx === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
      ctx.stroke();

      // Glossy broth-coated wet highlight on upper noodle strands
      if (n.depth > 0.48) {
        const specGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-halfLen * 0.65, 0, halfLen * 0.65, 0);
        specGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 240, 198, 0)');
        specGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 244, 208, ${(n.depth - 0.42) * 0.75})`);
        specGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 240, 198, 0)');
        ctx.strokeStyle = specGrad;
        ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness * 0.32;
        ctx.beginPath();
        pts.forEach((p, idx) => idx === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y - n.thickness * 0.22) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y - n.thickness * 0.22));
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

    const sticks = [

    ];

    for (const st of sticks) {

    // 1. Soft rising warm thermal haze immediately above the hot broth

        // Multi-frequency turbulent curl

      }

      }

      const botPt = spine[0];

      const colWarm = r.warmTint ? '255, 226, 192' : '236, 224, 214';

      plumeGrad.addColorStop(0.16, `rgba(${colWarm}, ${peakAlpha * 0.85})`);

      plumeGrad.addColorStop(0.78, `rgba(222, 212, 206, ${peakAlpha * 0.42})`);

    const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      centerX, centerY - 25 * sceneScale, Math.min(vw, vh) * 0.28,
      centerX, centerY - 10 * sceneScale, Math.hypot(vw, vh) * 0.58
    );

    vig.addColorStop(0.65, 'rgba(4, 2, 1, 0.32)');
    vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 0, 0.82)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vig;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
  }

  // MAIN RENDER LOOP
  // ============================================================================

  let lastFrameTime = performance.now();

  function render(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000);
    lastFrameTime = now;
    const time = now * 0.001;

    // Smoothly damp camera parallax & key light toward pointer
    const damp = 1 - Math.exp(-5.5 * dt);
    pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * damp;
    pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * damp;

    const targetLX = pointer.active ? pointer.tx * 0.85 : -0.22 + (prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.35) * 0.08);
    const targetLY = pointer.active ? pointer.ty * 0.75 : -0.32 + (prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(time * 0.28) * 0.06);
    pointer.lx += (targetLX - pointer.lx) * damp;
    pointer.ly += (targetLY - pointer.ly) * damp;
    pointer.vx *= 0.88;
    pointer.vy *= 0.88;

    // Advance interactive ripples & occasional delicate ambient simmer pulse
    if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
      for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        ripples[i].age += dt;
        if (ripples[i].age >= ripples[i].maxAge) {
          ripples.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
      // Subtle natural heat convection micro-ripple every few seconds
      if (ripples.length < 2 && Math.random() < dt * 0.45) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = Math.random() * 160;
        spawnRipple(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.56, 0.38);
      }
    } else if (ripples.length > 0) {
      ripples.length = 0;
    }

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    // 1. Dark atmospheric backdrop & charred wood counter
    drawBackgroundAndTable(time);

    // 2. Bowl scene transform with subtle 3D parallax response
    ctx.save();
    const camShiftX = pointer.x * 18 * sceneScale;
    const camShiftY = pointer.y * 11 * sceneScale;
    ctx.translate(centerX + camShiftX, centerY + camShiftY);
    ctx.scale(sceneScale, sceneScale);

    // Grounding bamboo mat
    drawWovenBambooMat();

    // Bowl interior cavity (behind nori & toppings)
    drawBowlInteriorWall();

    // Crisp roasted Nori sheets tucked inside upper-right rim (rising above lip)
    drawNoriSheets(time);

    // Clip broth & submerged contents cleanly inside the bowl interior ellipse
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 14, 302, 174, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();

    drawBrothBase(time);
    drawNoodles(time);
    drawAromaticOilsAndRipples(time);

    ctx.restore();

    // Toppings resting in & cresting slightly above the rich vegan broth
    drawCharredTofuSlabs(time);
    drawShiitakeAndKingOyster(time);
    drawBokChoy(time);
    drawMenmaAndCorn(time);
    drawScallionsSesameAndThreads(time);

    // Foreground bowl exterior ceramic wall & upper lip rim (occluding front edge of broth naturally)
    drawBowlExteriorAndShadow();
    drawBowlLipRim();

    // Resting chopsticks beside the bowl
    drawChopsticksOnHashioki();

    // Volumetric rising steam & interactive ribbons
    drawSteam(time);

    ctx.restore();

    // 3. Floating warm motes & cinematic vignette
    drawAtmosphericMotesAndVignette(time);

    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }

  buildStaticTextures();
  buildSceneData();
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(render);
})();

  'use strict';

  const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });

  // Deterministic PRNG for organic culinary textures & reproducible layout
  function mulberry32(seed) {
    return function() {
      let t = seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
      t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);

    const bundleConfigs = [

  function resize() {
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    vw = window.innerWidth;
    vh = window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = Math.round(vw * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(vh * dpr);

    // Responsive framing: ensure the bowl fills portraits generously while preserving steam headroom on landscapes
    const isPortrait = vh > vw * 1.08;
    const designW = isPortrait ? 760 : 920;
    const designH = isPortrait ? 780 : 800;
    sceneScale = Math.min(vw / designW, vh / designH) * (isPortrait ? 1.02 : 1.05);
    sceneScale = Math.max(0.36, Math.min(sceneScale, 1.75));

    centerX = vw * 0.5;
    centerY = vh * (isPortrait ? 0.575 : 0.565);
  }

  function spawnRipple(bx, by, strength = 1.0) {
    if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
    const norm = (bx * bx) / (296 * 296) + (by * by) / (170 * 170);
    if (norm <= 0.96) {
      ripples.push({
        x: bx,
        y: by,
        age: 0,
        maxAge: 2.5,
        maxRadius: 62 + strength * 68,
        strength: Math.min(1.35, strength)
      });
      if (ripples.length > 12) ripples.shift();
    }
  }

  function screenToBowl(clientX, clientY) {
    const camX = pointer.x * 18 * sceneScale;
    const camY = pointer.y * 11 * sceneScale;
    const bx = (clientX - (centerX + camX)) / sceneScale;
    const by = (clientY - (centerY + camY)) / sceneScale;
    return { bx, by };
  }

  // Interactive pointer / touch handlers
  window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
    const nx = (e.clientX / Math.max(1, vw)) * 2 - 1;
    const ny = (e.clientY / Math.max(1, vh)) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.vx = nx - pointer.tx;
    pointer.vy = ny - pointer.ty;
    pointer.tx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, nx));
    pointer.ty = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny));
    pointer.active = true;

    const { bx, by } = screenToBowl(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    const brothNorm = (bx * bx) / (296 * 296) + ((by - 14) * (by - 14)) / (170 * 170);
    pointer.overBroth = brothNorm < 0.96;

    const now = performance.now();
    const speed = Math.hypot(pointer.vx, pointer.vy);
    if (pointer.overBroth && speed > 0.011 && now - lastRippleTime > 110) {
      spawnRipple(bx, by - 14, Math.min(1.05, speed * 15));
      lastRippleTime = now;
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
    const nx = (e.clientX / Math.max(1, vw)) * 2 - 1;
    const ny = (e.clientY / Math.max(1, vh)) * 2 - 1;
    pointer.tx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, nx));
    pointer.ty = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny));
    pointer.active = true;

    const { bx, by } = screenToBowl(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    spawnRipple(bx, by - 14, 1.2);
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    pointer.active = false;
    pointer.overBroth = false;
    pointer.tx = 0;

  function drawNoodles(time) {
    // Cohesive, glossy alkaline wheat noodles folded gracefully in the broth
    ctx.save();
    for (const n of sceneData.noodles) {
      const sway = prefersReducedMotion
        ? 0
        : Math.sin(time * 1.1 + n.swayOffset) * 1.7 * (0.35 + n.depth * 0.65);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(n.cx, n.cy + sway * 0.45);
      ctx.rotate(n.baseAngle);

      const steps = 22;
      const halfLen = n.length * 0.5;
      const pts = [];
      for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
        const u = s / steps;
        const x = -halfLen + u * n.length;
        const env = Math.sin(u * Math.PI); // 0 submerged ends -> 1 surfacing crest
        const crinkle = Math.sin(x * n.waveFreq + n.phase + sway * 0.32) * n.waveAmp;
        const y = crinkle * (0.45 + 0.55 * env) - env * n.arch;
        pts.push({ x, y });
      }

      // Warm amber-brown ambient occlusion between adjacent noodle strands
      if (n.depth > 0.22) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(68, 28, 5, ${0.22 + n.depth * 0.28})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness + 3.4;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.beginPath();
        pts.forEach((p, idx) => idx === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y + 3.0) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + 3.0));
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Golden wheat noodle body (submerged tips blend organically into miso broth)
      const strandGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-halfLen, 0, halfLen, 0);
      const midAlpha = 0.42 + n.depth * 0.58;
      const rCol = Math.round(224 + n.depth * 28);
      const gCol = Math.round(166 + n.depth * 44);
      const bCol = Math.round(70 + n.depth * 38);

      strandGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(184, 108, 36, 0)');
      strandGrad.addColorStop(0.16, `rgba(${rCol - 24}, ${gCol - 28}, ${bCol - 22}, ${midAlpha * 0.78})`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(${rCol}, ${gCol}, ${bCol}, ${midAlpha})`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(0.84, `rgba(${rCol - 24}, ${gCol - 28}, ${bCol - 22}, ${midAlpha * 0.78})`);
      strandGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(184, 108, 36, 0)');

      ctx.strokeStyle = strandGrad;
      ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      pts.forEach((p, idx) => idx === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y) : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
      ctx.stroke();

      // Broth-kissed glossy specular ribbon along cresting noodle strands
      if (n.depth > 0.44) {
        const specGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-halfLen * 0.68, 0, halfLen * 0.68, 0);
        specGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 245, 205, 0)');
        specGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 248, 218, ${(n.depth - 0.38) * 0.78})`);
        specGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 245, 205, 0)');
        ctx.strokeStyle = specGrad;
        ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness * 0.32;
        ctx.beginPath();
        pts.forEach((p, idx) => idx === 0
          ? ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y - n.thickness * 0.22)
          : ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y - n.thickness * 0.22));
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }

    const threads = [
      [-18, 16, -2, -4, 16, 12],

      [-2, -2, 14, 14, 4, 28],

  function drawBowlFrontExteriorAndLip() {
    const lx = pointer.lx;
    const ly = pointer.ly;

    // 1. Ceramic Foot Ring (Kodai - unglazed iron stoneware base)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-132, 144);
    ctx.lineTo(-124, 176);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-65, 202, 65, 202, 124, 176);
    ctx.lineTo(132, 144);
    ctx.closePath();

    const footGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-132, 158, 132, 168);
    footGrad.addColorStop(0, '#15100d');
    footGrad.addColorStop(0.28 + lx * 0.1, '#2c2119');
    footGrad.addColorStop(0.65, '#191310');
    footGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0c0907');
    ctx.fillStyle = footGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(198, 148, 106, 0.18)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-123, 175);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-64, 200, 64, 200, 123, 175);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // 2. Handcrafted Stoneware Donburi Front Exterior Wall
    // Occludes only the front lower half (0..PI), allowing tall toppings on the back rim (nori) to stand proudly above
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(-330, 0);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-328, 98, -236, 165, -130, 158);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-55, 180, 55, 180, 130, 158);
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(236, 165, 328, 98, 330, 0);
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 330, 192, 0, 0, Math.PI, false);
    ctx.closePath();

    const specX = lx * 145 - 65;
    const specY = 80 + ly * 22;
    const bodyGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(specX, specY, 18, 0, 90, 360);
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#3d342e');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.28, '#251f1c');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.62, '#151210');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(0.88, '#0c0a09');
    bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1a1411');
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.clip();

    // Wheel-thrown potter's ribs (rokuro-me)
    const ridgeYs = [54, 88, 120, 146];
    ridgeYs.forEach((ryBase, idx) => {
      const curveDepth = 158 - idx * 28;
      ctx.strokeStyle = idx % 2 === 0
        ? 'rgba(255, 224, 190, 0.048)'
        : 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
      ctx.beginPath();

      ctx.bezierCurveTo(-165, ryBase + curveDepth * 0.55, 165, ryBase + curveDepth * 0.55, 325, ryBase - 32);

    });

    glazeHighlight.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255, 186, 130, 0.045)');
    glazeHighlight.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 186, 130, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = glazeHighlight;
    ctx.fillRect(-340, 0, 680, 205);

    const rimBounce = ctx.createRadialGradient(180, 138, 10, 180, 138, 152);
    rimBounce.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(228, 130, 58, 0.11)');
    rimBounce.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(228, 130, 58, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = rimBounce;
    ctx.fillRect(-340, 0, 680, 205);

    ctx.restore();
    ctx.restore();

    // 3. Front Half of Glazed Ceramic Lip Rim (0..PI) — seamlessly connects to back lip drawn earlier
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 330, 192, 0, -0.05, Math.PI + 0.05, false);
    ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 314, 182, 0, Math.PI + 0.05, -0.05, true);
    ctx.closePath();

      lx * 260 - 120, ly * 150 - 160,

    );
    lipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#5c4534');
    lipGrad.addColorStop(0.32, '#3d2d23');
    lipGrad.addColorStop(0.66, '#251c17');
    lipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3f2f23');

  function drawBowlBackLip() {
    const lx = pointer.lx;
    const ly = pointer.ly;

    // Back Half of Glazed Ceramic Lip Rim (PI..2*PI), drawn BEHIND the nori sheets so nori sits inside the bowl!
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 330, 192, 0, Math.PI - 0.06, Math.PI * 2 + 0.06, false);
    ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 314, 182, 0, Math.PI * 2 + 0.06, Math.PI - 0.06, true);
    ctx.closePath();

    const lipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(
      lx * 260 - 120, ly * 150 - 160,
      -lx * 260 + 120, -ly * 150 + 160
    );
    lipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#614937');
    lipGrad.addColorStop(0.45, '#3b2c22');
    lipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#261d17');
    ctx.fillStyle = lipGrad;
    ctx.fill();

    // Back ceramic lip specular catchlight
    const backLightStart = Math.PI + 0.35 + lx * 0.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 230, 198, 0.36)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 1, 322, 187, 0, backLightStart, backLightStart + 1.15);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // SOFT BILLOWING VOLUMETRIC STEAM (PUFF-BASED FLUID VAPOR)
  // ============================================================================

  function drawVolumetricSteam(time) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

    // 1. Soft rising warm thermal glow immediately above the steaming broth
    const hazePulse = prefersReducedMotion ? 1 : 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(time * 1.1);
    const thermalHaze = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      pointer.x * 20, -55, 18,
      pointer.x * 32, -135, 345
    );
    thermalHaze.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 212, 164, ${0.12 * hazePulse})`);
    thermalHaze.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(232, 180, 135, ${0.055 * hazePulse})`);
    thermalHaze.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200, 155, 120, 0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = thermalHaze;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(pointer.x * 24, -125, 345, 255, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Cursor in bowl-local coordinates for fluid steam parting & wake eddies
    const cursorBX = pointer.tx * (vw * 0.5) / sceneScale - pointer.x * 18;
    const cursorBY = (pointer.ty * (vh * 0.5) - (centerY - vh * 0.5)) / sceneScale - pointer.y * 11;

    // 2. Render overlapping soft radial vapor puffs along curling organic trajectories
    for (const col of sceneData.steamColumns) {
      const sprite = col.warm ? steamPuffWarm : steamPuffCool;
      const count = col.puffsPerColumn;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        // Continuous normalized height u in [0, 1)
        const baseU = i / count;
        const u = prefersReducedMotion
          ? (baseU + col.phase * 0.1) % 1
          : (baseU + time * col.speed + col.phase) % 1;

        // Vertical ascent with gentle buoyant acceleration
        const py = col.originY - Math.pow(u, 0.94) * col.height;

        // Multi-harmonic curl & billowing drift
        const flowPhase = prefersReducedMotion ? col.phase : time * 0.85 + col.phase;
        const curl1 = Math.sin(u * col.swayFreq * Math.PI * 1.4 - flowPhase * 1.5) * col.swayAmp * Math.pow(u, 0.82);
        const curl2 = Math.cos(u * 4.5 - flowPhase * 0.9 + i * 0.7) * (col.swayAmp * 0.36) * u;
        let px = col.originX * (1 - u * 0.12) + curl1 + curl2;

        // Interactive mouse breeze & fluid wake deflection
        if (pointer.active) {
          const dx = px - cursorBX;
          const dy = py - cursorBY;
          const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          const influenceR = 175;
          if (distSq < influenceR * influenceR) {
            const dist = Math.max(14, Math.sqrt(distSq));
            const push = Math.pow(1 - dist / influenceR, 2) * 56 * Math.pow(u, 0.6);
            px += (dx / dist) * push + pointer.vx * 220 * u;
          }
          px += pointer.x * 26 * u * u;
        }

        // Smooth fade-in from broth surface and silky dissipation high above
        const fadeIn = Math.min(1, u / 0.18);
        const fadeOut = Math.pow(1 - u, 1.45);
        const alpha = col.opacity * fadeIn * fadeOut;
        if (alpha <= 0.006) continue;

        const radius = col.baseRadius + (col.topRadius - col.baseRadius) * Math.pow(u, 0.95);
        const stretchY = 1.12 + u * 0.35;

        ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
        ctx.drawImage(
          sprite,
          px - radius,
          py - radius * stretchY,
          radius * 2,
          radius * 2 * stretchY
        );
      }
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawAtmosphericMotesAndVignette(time) {
    // 1. Warm floating vapor motes & subtle bokeh
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

    for (const m of sceneData.motes) {
      const yTravel = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : (time * m.speedY) % (vh * 1.1);
      const rawY = centerY + m.ny * vh * 0.48 - yTravel;
      const y = ((rawY % vh) + vh) % vh;
      const swayX = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.65 + m.phase) * m.driftX;
      const x = centerX + m.nx * vw * 0.46 + swayX - pointer.x * 24 * (m.r * 0.3);

      const edgeFade = Math.sin((y / Math.max(1, vh)) * Math.PI);
      const alpha = m.alpha * Math.max(0, edgeFade);
      if (alpha <= 0.005) continue;

      const r = m.r * sceneScale;
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r * 2.2);
      if (m.warm) {
        grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 206, 140, ${alpha})`);
        grad.addColorStop(0.45, `rgba(235, 146, 68, ${alpha * 0.4})`);
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(235, 146, 68, 0)');
      } else {
        grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 238, 218, ${alpha * 0.8})`);
        grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 238, 218, 0)');
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x, y, r * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // 2. Deep cinematic vignette keeping attention solely on the steaming bowl
    const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      centerX, centerY - 25 * sceneScale, Math.min(vw, vh) * 0.28,
      centerX, centerY - 10 * sceneScale, Math.hypot(vw, vh) * 0.58
    );
    vig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    vig.addColorStop(0.64, 'rgba(4, 2, 1, 0.34)');
    vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(2, 1, 0, 0.85)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vig;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, vw, vh);
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // ANIMATION LOOP
  // ============================================================================

  let lastFrameTime = performance.now();

  function render(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastFrameTime) / 1000);
    lastFrameTime = now;
    const time = now * 0.001;

    // Smoothly damp camera parallax & key light toward pointer
    const damp = 1 - Math.exp(-5.5 * dt);
    pointer.x += (pointer.tx - pointer.x) * damp;
    pointer.y += (pointer.ty - pointer.y) * damp;

    const targetLX = pointer.active
      ? pointer.tx * 0.85
      : -0.22 + (prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : Math.sin(time * 0.35) * 0.08);
    const targetLY = pointer.active
      ? pointer.ty * 0.75
      : -0.32 + (prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : Math.cos(time * 0.28) * 0.06);
    pointer.lx += (targetLX - pointer.lx) * damp;
    pointer.ly += (targetLY - pointer.ly) * damp;
    pointer.vx *= 0.88;
    pointer.vy *= 0.88;

    // Update broth ripples & subtle natural heat convection pulses
    if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
      for (let i = ripples.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        ripples[i].age += dt;
        if (ripples[i].age >= ripples[i].maxAge) {
          ripples.splice(i, 1);
        }
      }
      if (ripples.length < 2 && Math.random() < dt * 0.45) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        const r = Math.random() * 155;
        spawnRipple(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r * 0.56, 0.38);
      }
    } else if (ripples.length > 0) {
      ripples.length = 0;
    }

    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

    // 1. Dark atmospheric backdrop & charred wood counter
    drawAtmosphereAndCounter();

    // 2. Solitary steaming bowl of vegan ramen with 3D mouse parallax
    ctx.save();
    const camShiftX = pointer.x * 18 * sceneScale;
    const camShiftY = pointer.y * 11 * sceneScale;
    ctx.translate(centerX + camShiftX, centerY + camShiftY);
    ctx.scale(sceneScale, sceneScale);

    // Cast & contact shadows on counter
    drawBowlShadow();

    // Bowl interior ceramic wall & back lip rim
    drawBowlInteriorWall();
    drawBowlBackLip();

    // Crisp roasted Nori sheets tucked inside back-right rim (rising naturally above back lip)
    drawNoriSheets(time);

    // Broth, noodles, aromatic oils & ripples clipped inside bowl interior
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(0, 14, 302, 174, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();

    drawBrothBase(time);
    drawNoodles(time);
    drawAromaticOilsAndRipples(time);

    ctx.restore();

    // Vibrant plant-based toppings resting in & cresting above the broth
    drawCharredTofuSlabs(time);
    drawShiitakeAndKingOyster(time);
    drawBokChoy(time);
    drawMenmaAndCorn(time);
    drawScallionsSesameAndThreads(time);

    // Front exterior stoneware wall & front lip rim (naturally occluding lower broth edge)
    drawBowlFrontExteriorAndLip();

    // Silky billowing volumetric steam rising from the hot bowl
    drawVolumetricSteam(time);

    ctx.restore();

    // 3. Ambient floating vapor motes & cinematic vignette
    drawAtmosphericMotesAndVignette(time);

    requestAnimationFrame(render);
  }

  buildProceduralTextures();
  buildSceneData();
  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(render);
})();
